admission.justification: Two unit tests verify that a failing lazy bridge import surfaces its own ImportError rather than crashing with UnboundLocalError inside except PaseoBridgeFailure while real bridge failures still report detail.

applicability: Host chat address derivation in cli/dashboard_address.py::chat_address_for when Paseo host settings are configured.
conditions: A non-blank agent_id and configured Paseo host settings trigger the lazy bridge import.
exclusions: Calls where agent_id is blank or Paseo settings are absent, which return before importing the bridge.
statement: chat_address_for performs its lazy import of PaseoBridgeFailure and bridge_call before entering try/except PaseoBridgeFailure so a failed import surfaces its own ImportError rather than UnboundLocalError.
title: chat_address_for imports PaseoBridgeFailure before entering try
